tui.about.note: The TUI talks to the same local service as the WebUI and desktop shell; it never stores secrets.
tui.agents.editNote: Agent definitions are Markdown files. Edit the definition file in your editor; changes are picked up on the next refresh.
tui.attach.title: Attach a file
tui.commit.branchRequired: Enter a branch name without spaces.
tui.confirm.archiveBody: Archive “{title}”? You can restore it from Settings › Archived conversations.
tui.confirm.deleteArchivedBody: Permanently delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
tui.confirm.deleteCredentialBody: Delete the credential “{name}”? Models using it stop working until another credential is added.
tui.confirm.removeProjectBody: Remove the project “{name}” from the list? Files on disk are not touched.
tui.confirm.stopMemoryBody: Stop the memory runtime? Memory writes pause until it starts again.
tui.empty.hint: Type a task below and press Enter. / opens commands, F1 shows keys.
tui.help.mouse: Click to focus or activate, double-click to open, right-click for menus, wheel to scroll
tui.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
tui.hint.ask: ↑↓ choose · Space toggle · Enter confirm · ←→ question · x stop · Esc back
tui.hint.composer: Enter send · Alt/Ctrl+Enter or \+Enter new line · Alt+V paste · / commands · Tab focus · Ctrl+P palette
tui.hint.nav: ↑↓ page · Enter open · / search · Esc chat
tui.hint.page: ↑↓ row · Enter/Space change · ←→ adjust · / search · Esc back
tui.hint.panel: ←→ tab · ↑↓ file · Enter diff · s stage · c commit · b branch · p push
tui.hint.sidebar: ↑↓ conversation · Enter open · n new · z fold all · Ctrl+B rail · Esc back
tui.hint.transcript: ↑↓ select · Enter fold · PgUp/PgDn scroll · End latest · Esc back
tui.history.title: Conversation history
tui.index.engineNote: Engine settings apply to every indexed project. Changing the embedding model or dimensions invalidates existing vectors.
tui.index.rebuildBody: Rebuild the semantic index of {name} from scratch? Search quality drops until it finishes.
tui.index.rebuildNote: Saving a new model or dimension marks every project for a full rebuild.
tui.inspector.title: Inspector
tui.jobs.title: Background jobs
tui.knowledge.modeNote: Raw searches original text; display searches normalized text; hybrid combines both.
tui.knowledge.rebuildBody: Rebuild the whole index of {name}? Searches may return partial results until it finishes.
tui.knowledge.removeSourceBody: Remove the source {path}? Its documents leave the library; files on disk are kept.
tui.knowledge.searchNote: Press / to search every knowledge base.
tui.memory.cleanupNote: Removes memories that were superseded or never recalled.
tui.memory.correctProfileNote: Describe what is wrong; the memory system rewrites the profile accordingly.
tui.memory.embeddingNote: Changing the embedding model or dimensions requires re-embedding stored memories.
tui.memory.projectsNote: How many memories each project holds.
tui.memory.refreshProfileNote: Rebuilds the user profile from recent conversations.
tui.memory.rerankNote: Reranking reorders recalled memories with a dedicated model before injection.
tui.memory.resourcesEditNote: Resource files are edited in your editor; the TUI shows their origin and can restore built-in versions.
tui.palette.title: Command palette
tui.panel.agentsHint: ↑↓ select · Enter details · m message · s stop · x end
tui.panel.statsHint: ↑↓ scroll · g edit goal · p pause/resume
tui.panel.title: Session tools
tui.plugins.note: Vulcan plugins extend the core with tools, hooks, skills and agents. Their core capabilities work here; plugin panels are WebUI-only for now.
tui.prompt.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
tui.settings.contextNote: Changes on this page are drafts until you save them.
tui.settings.credentialNote: Secrets are sent to the service once and never shown again; only the last characters are displayed.
tui.settings.localeNote: Choosing a language here also saves it as your WebUI language.
tui.settings.secretKeep: Stored masked by the service. Leave the prompt blank to keep the current value.
tui.settings.secretNote: Paste the API key for {provider}. It is masked on screen and sent once.
tui.skills.editNote: Skill bodies are edited as files. Open the skill folder in your editor; the TUI manages enablement, overrides and removal.
tui.web.mock: Mock mode: WebUI would open at {url}
